github_outputs.structured_value: JSON object with exactly eight boolean properties

canonical_events.source: push to a configured integration branch
same-repository pull request from a non-integration branch

suppressed_event.source: same-repository pull request from the main or master integration branch

jobs.name: compatibility-roll/evaluate
owns: rolling compatibility evaluation and candidate promotion
jobs.applicable_when: the weekly schedule or a manual compatibility evaluation is triggered
jobs.not_applicable: workflow is not triggered outside its schedule or explicit dispatch
jobs.implementation_status: immutable candidates are promoted or quarantined through a signed review pull request

jobs.name: normal-ci/plan
owns: changed-path classification for all eight regions
jobs.applicable_when: the Normal CI push or pull-request event is elected as canonical for the SHA
jobs.not_applicable: a same-repository pull request from the main or master integration branch is suppressed because its push event owns the SHA

jobs.name: normal-ci/fast
jobs.command: nix run .#ci-parallel -- formatting nix fmt -- --ci --next static nix run .#ci-fast
owns: Ruff lint and format checks through treefmt
jobs.applicable_when: the Normal CI push or pull-request event is elected as canonical for the SHA
jobs.not_applicable: a same-repository pull request from the main or master integration branch is suppressed because its push event owns the SHA

jobs.name: normal-ci/rust_contracts
jobs.command: nix run .#ci-rust-contracts for Rust and contract changes; nix run .#rust-ci-core for Rust-only changes; nix run .#contract-check for contract-only changes
owns: Rust Clippy, build, tests, and compatibility checks
jobs.applicable_when: the rust or contracts region is selected
jobs.not_applicable: the planning job records both rust and contracts as false and GitHub concludes skipped

jobs.name: normal-ci/python_tests
jobs.applicable_when: the python region is selected
jobs.not_applicable: the planning job records python as false and GitHub concludes skipped

jobs.name: normal-ci/routing_mutations
jobs.applicable_when: the routing region is selected
jobs.not_applicable: the planning job records routing as false and GitHub concludes skipped

jobs.name: normal-ci/web
owns: Web type, test, and static-build checks
jobs.applicable_when: the web region is selected
jobs.not_applicable: the planning job records web as false and GitHub concludes skipped

jobs.name: normal-ci/product_flake
jobs.command: nix run .#product-smoke for product changes; nix flake check --no-build plus remote metadata and default-app help for remote_flake changes
owns: immutable worker, UI, SPA, and CLI product smoke checks
remote SHA metadata and default-app help
jobs.applicable_when: the product or remote_flake region is selected
jobs.not_applicable: the planning job records both product and remote_flake as false and GitHub concludes skipped

jobs.name: normal-ci/windows
jobs.applicable_when: the rust region is selected
jobs.not_applicable: the planning job records rust as false and GitHub concludes skipped

jobs.name: normal-ci/required
jobs.applicable_when: always for the elected Normal CI event, including when dependencies fail or are skipped
jobs.not_applicable: a same-repository pull request from the main or master integration branch is suppressed because its push event owns the SHA

jobs.name: package/plan
owns: Package CI changed-path classification for all eight regions
jobs.applicable_when: the Package CI push or pull-request event is elected as canonical for the SHA
jobs.not_applicable: a same-repository pull request from the main or master integration branch is suppressed because its push event owns the SHA

jobs.name: package/linux
jobs.command: nix run .#tauri-build -- --bundles deb && nix run .#package-smoke -- dist/tauri/*.deb && nix run .#package-install-smoke -- dist/tauri/*.deb
owns: Linux clean install, offline startup, upgrade, and uninstall
jobs.applicable_when: the product region is selected
jobs.not_applicable: the planning job records product as false and GitHub concludes skipped

jobs.name: package/linux_repro
jobs.applicable_when: the product region is selected
jobs.not_applicable: the planning job records product as false and GitHub concludes skipped

jobs.name: package/repro_check
owns: byte-for-byte comparison of independently built Debian artifacts
jobs.applicable_when: the product region is selected and both Debian builds succeed
jobs.not_applicable: the planning job records product as false and GitHub concludes skipped; a failed prerequisite is an aggregate failure

jobs.name: package/windows
owns: Windows clean install, startup, upgrade, and uninstall
jobs.applicable_when: the product region is selected
jobs.not_applicable: the planning job records product as false and GitHub concludes skipped

jobs.name: package/windows_repro
jobs.applicable_when: the product region is selected
jobs.not_applicable: the planning job records product as false and GitHub concludes skipped

jobs.name: package/windows_repro_check
jobs.command: nix shell -p coreutils diffutils --command bash -c 'sha256sum and cmp byte-for-byte comparison of independently built NSIS artifacts'
owns: byte-for-byte comparison of independently built NSIS artifacts
jobs.applicable_when: the product region is selected and both NSIS builds succeed
jobs.not_applicable: the planning job records product as false and GitHub concludes skipped; a failed prerequisite is an aggregate failure

jobs.name: package/required
jobs.applicable_when: always for the elected Package CI event, including when package jobs fail or are skipped
jobs.not_applicable: a same-repository pull request from the main or master integration branch is suppressed because its push event owns the SHA

jobs.name: release/linux
jobs.command: nix run .#release-check -- --tag <tag> && nix run .#check && nix run .#tauri-build -- --bundles deb
owns: Linux release package, reproducibility, checksums, and signing inputs
jobs.applicable_when: a v* tag is pushed and its version matches every release artifact
jobs.not_applicable: workflow is not triggered outside v* tags; missing artifacts on a tag is an error

jobs.name: release/windows
owns: Windows release installer, reproducibility, checksums, and signing inputs
jobs.applicable_when: a v* tag is pushed and its version matches every release artifact
jobs.not_applicable: workflow is not triggered outside v* tags; missing artifacts on a tag is an error

jobs.name: release/github-release
jobs.applicable_when: a v* tag is pushed and all package jobs and signed artifact checks succeed
jobs.not_applicable: workflow is not triggered outside v* tags; missing artifacts on a tag is an error

aggregate_contract.implementation_status: exact dual region evidence and job results are implemented in Normal CI and Package CI

current_implementation.installer_action_role: installs Nix; it does not configure a PokeCon-specific binary cache
current_implementation.trust_boundary: cryptographic Nix signature verification when the repository public-key secret is configured; otherwise the optional substituter is not enabled
current_implementation.public_key: GitHub Actions secret POKECON_NIX_CACHE_PUBLIC_KEY (not stored in the repository)
current_implementation.secret_key_source: GitHub Actions secret POKECON_NIX_CACHE_SECRET_KEY (repository secret, never printed)
current_implementation.writer_condition: github.event_name == 'push' && contains(fromJSON('["yqYo1"]'), github.actor) && cache-hit != 'true' && signing and public keys are configured
current_implementation.reader_condition: unrestricted restore via actions/cache/restore; the Nix substituter is enabled only with require-sigs=true and the configured public key
current_implementation.trusted_writer_flow: sign store paths before nix copy with the secret key; no trusted=true file-store option
current_implementation.head_ref_exclusion_removed: github.head_ref != 'refactor/rust-core' removed from plan/fast/required gating so PRs from refactor/rust-core execute required aggregates (no bypass)

report_evidence: cache actor, event, read, and write permissions
same_sha_comparison_requires: at least one substituted PokeCon store path
